## Name

Proposed directory name (lowercase, hyphens): `employees/<department>/<name>/`

## Department

One of the 12 in `employees/`, or propose a new one.

## Job

What does this specialist do that no current employee covers? One paragraph.

## Trigger phrases

What would a user type that should route here? (5+ examples)

## Why not an existing employee

Which current employee is closest, and why is it not enough?

## Worked example and output

Give one synthetic input and the deliverable this specialist should produce.
State what a reviewer can check, what tools it needs, and when it must stop or
hand off. Label proposed output separately from anything you actually ran.

## Implementation scope after review

Use the [new skill checklist](../../docs/new-skill-template/README.md). A reviewed
addition includes the skill and companion files, active roster, routing policy
and probes, catalog, updated counts and docs. The library can grow beyond its
current 61 specialists; opening a proposal does not silently register a new role.
